agency2.speaker: agency
agency2.text: Hesper-4 has stopped reporting. It is a one man job.

x_notagun.speaker: xander
x_notagun.text: This is for fence posts. I want that noted.

x_nocatch.speaker: xander
x_nocatch.text: Safety catch. There is no safety catch.

x_see1.speaker: xander
x_see1.text: No. No, that is not a chicken.

x_see3.speaker: xander
x_see3.text: Stay there. Stay - no, of course not.

x_see4.speaker: xander
x_see4.text: I fed you. I actually fed you.

x_see6.speaker: xander
x_see6.text: Twelve years of night shifts for this.

x_see7.speaker: xander
x_see7.text: That one has a tag. Pen four. I know that one.

x_see8.speaker: xander
x_see8.text: It is looking at the gun. It knows what the gun is.

x_see9.speaker: xander
x_see9.text: Keep coming. Save me the walk.

x_see10.speaker: xander
x_see10.text: That is not how legs bend.

x_see12.speaker: xander
x_see12.text: Bigger than the last one. They keep being bigger.

x_see13.speaker: xander
x_see13.text: I signed for that animal. Personally.

x_see14.speaker: xander
x_see14.text: Do not run at me. Do not - fine.

x_kill2.speaker: xander
x_kill2.text: That is coming out of my wages somehow.

x_kill4.speaker: xander
x_kill4.text: Do not make me do that again.

x_kill5.speaker: xander
x_kill5.text: I liked this job. Past tense.

x_kill8.speaker: xander
x_kill8.text: Head office can count them. I am done counting.

x_kill9.speaker: xander
x_kill9.text: That was a good bird, once.

x_kill11.speaker: xander
x_kill11.text: Add it to the list. There is a list now.

x_kill12.speaker: xander
x_kill12.text: I used to name them. I have stopped.

x_hurt2.speaker: xander
x_hurt2.text: That is going to need a tetanus.

x_hurt4.speaker: xander
x_hurt4.text: Through the shirt. Through the actual shirt.

x_hurt5.speaker: xander
x_hurt5.text: Not the leg. I need the leg.

x_hurt6.speaker: xander
x_hurt6.text: Get off me. Get off, get -

x_low1.speaker: xander
x_low1.text: Right. Right. I am fine. I am fine.

x_low2.speaker: xander
x_low2.text: I am not paid enough to bleed.

x_low3.speaker: xander
x_low3.text: Medical bay is unstaffed. Of course it is.

x_low4.speaker: xander
x_low4.text: That is a lot of me on the floor.

x_low6.speaker: xander
x_low6.text: If I sit down I will not get up.

x_ammo1.speaker: xander
x_ammo1.text: Running dry. Of course I am.

x_ammo2.speaker: xander
x_ammo2.text: Who signs off on one crate?

x_ammo3.speaker: xander
x_ammo3.text: Count them. Count them again. Same number.

x_ammo5.speaker: xander
x_ammo5.text: Doyle had the spare crate. Doyle went home.

x_empty2.speaker: xander
x_empty2.text: Click. That is the whole noise now. Click.

x_empty3.speaker: xander
x_empty3.text: Nothing. It makes a nothing noise.

x_safe1.speaker: xander
x_safe1.text: A door that shuts. I could cry.

x_safe3.speaker: xander
x_safe3.text: Nobody knows I am down here.

x_safe4.speaker: xander
x_safe4.text: A chair. There is a chair. I am having the chair.

x_safe5.speaker: xander
x_safe5.text: The kettle works. The kettle. Not the doors.

x_safe6.speaker: xander
x_safe6.text: Somebody left their lunch. Tuesday, by the smell.

x_safe7.speaker: xander
x_safe7.text: Do not fall asleep. Do not - do not fall asleep.

x_safe8.speaker: xander
x_safe8.text: There is a poster about lifting with the knees.

x_lift1.speaker: xander
x_lift1.text: Down. It only ever goes down.

x_lift2.speaker: xander
x_lift2.text: Seven seconds of nothing trying to eat me.

x_lift3.speaker: xander
x_lift3.text: They fixed the music. Not the doors. The music.

x_lift4.speaker: xander
x_lift4.text: Inspection tag says March. Which March.

x_lift5.speaker: xander
x_lift5.text: If this stops between decks I am staying in it.

x_lift7.speaker: xander
x_lift7.text: Deeper. Right. Deeper is where the answer is.

x_lift8.speaker: xander
x_lift8.text: Nobody serviced this. Nobody serviced anything.

x_idle1.speaker: xander
x_idle1.text: Why is it me. Why is it always me.

x_idle2.speaker: xander
x_idle2.text: Doyle had the pass card. Doyle went home.

x_idle3.speaker: xander
x_idle3.text: The training video was eleven minutes long.

x_idle4.speaker: xander
x_idle4.text: I am a farmhand. That is the whole of it.

x_idle5.speaker: xander
x_idle5.text: Somebody in an office decided this was fine.

x_idle6.speaker: xander
x_idle6.text: They cut the safety budget. Twice.

x_idle7.speaker: xander
x_idle7.text: I have a flat. I would like to see it again.

x_idle8.speaker: xander
x_idle8.text: Not a hero. Just the last one holding a key.

x_idle9.speaker: xander
x_idle9.text: Everyone who could have stopped this got a bonus.

x_idle10.speaker: xander
x_idle10.text: If anything down here is listening: I resign.

x_idle11.speaker: xander
x_idle11.text: It smells like the feed store. It should not.

x_idle12.speaker: xander
x_idle12.text: Whatever this is, it is above my pay grade.

x_idle13.speaker: xander
x_idle13.text: The contract said light maintenance. Light.

x_idle14.speaker: xander
x_idle14.text: Forty minutes on hold to report a leak. Forty.

x_idle15.speaker: xander
x_idle15.text: Somebody laminated the evacuation plan. Had the time.

x_idle16.speaker: xander
x_idle16.text: Head office is eleven weeks away by post.

x_idle17.speaker: xander
x_idle17.text: I had a plan for Tuesday. It involved a chair.

x_idle18.speaker: xander
x_idle18.text: The union rep left on the first shuttle.

x_idle19.speaker: xander
x_idle19.text: They stopped restocking the biscuits in June.

x_idle20.speaker: xander
x_idle20.text: Every door down here needs a card. One card. Doyle.

x_idle21.speaker: xander
x_idle21.text: The feed order was doubled in spring. Nobody asked why.

x_idle22.speaker: xander
x_idle22.text: Hazard pay is a line on a form. It is not pay.

x_idle23.speaker: xander
x_idle23.text: There was a memo about the lights. I did not read it.

x_idle24.speaker: xander
x_idle24.text: Six months accident free, the sign says. Six months.

x_idle25.speaker: xander
x_idle25.text: My boots are the only thing on this deck I trust.

x_idle26.speaker: xander
x_idle26.text: Whoever built this put the shed at the far end.

x_idle27.speaker: xander
x_idle27.text: Half the doors here open the wrong way. Half.

x_idle28.speaker: xander
x_idle28.text: Nobody in the training video had a limp. I noticed.

x_cough1.speaker: xander
x_cough1.text: Kh - that is not air. That is not air.

x_cough2.speaker: xander
x_cough2.text: Gas. Of course there is gas.

x_cough4.speaker: xander
x_cough4.text: There is a valve. There is always a valve.

pa1.speaker: host
pa1.text: ATTENTION. All personnel report to muster. Thank you.

pa2.speaker: host
pa2.text: ATTENTION. Livestock deck sealed pending inspection.

pa3.speaker: host
pa3.text: Reminder: hand contact with stock is not permitted.

pa4.speaker: host
pa4.text: ATTENTION. Air handling is operating normally.

pa5.speaker: host
pa5.text: Please report any unusual behaviour to your supervisor.

pa6.speaker: host
pa6.text: ATTENTION. The medical bay is unstaffed this rotation.

pa7.speaker: host
pa7.text: Your safety is our second priority.

pa8.speaker: host
pa8.text: ATTENTION. Feed cycle complete. Feed cycle complete.

pa9.speaker: host
pa9.text: - and we thank you for another productive season.

pa10.speaker: host
pa10.text: ATTENTION. Do not approach the pens without a partner.

pa11.speaker: host
pa11.text: Good morning, Hesper-4. Shift change is in effect.

pa12.speaker: host
pa12.text: Reminder: the canteen closes at nineteen hundred.

pa13.speaker: host
pa13.text: ATTENTION. Lift maintenance is scheduled. Thank you.

pa14.speaker: host
pa14.text: Please keep the corridors clear of personal effects.

pa15.speaker: host
pa15.text: Hesper-4 has been accident free for six months.

pa16.speaker: host
pa16.text: ATTENTION. Deck lighting is in economy mode. Thank you.

pa17.speaker: host
pa17.text: Reminder: hearing protection is available at the desk.

pa18.speaker: host
pa18.text: A pleasant and productive shift to all of you.

pa19.speaker: host
pa19.text: ATTENTION. Please log all pen counts before you leave.

pa20.speaker: host
pa20.text: The company values every single one of you.

pa73.speaker: host
pa73.text: ATTENTION. Visitors must be accompanied at all times.

pa74.speaker: host
pa74.text: Reminder: the suggestion box is beside the lift.

pa75.speaker: host
pa75.text: ATTENTION. Deck four is closed for cleaning. Thank you.

pa21.speaker: host
pa21.text: ATTENTION. Overtime is mandatory this rotation.

pa22.speaker: host
pa22.text: Reminder: absence without a note is deducted.

pa23.speaker: host
pa23.text: ATTENTION. Processing quota unmet. Processing quota unmet.

pa24.speaker: host
pa24.text: The intercom is for operational use only. Thank you.

pa25.speaker: host
pa25.text: Reminder: incident reports are due by end of shift.

pa26.speaker: host
pa26.text: ATTENTION. Rest breaks are suspended until further notice.

pa27.speaker: host
pa27.text: Personal calls will be logged and charged.

pa28.speaker: host
pa28.text: ATTENTION. Do not feed the stock by hand. It is noted.

pa30.speaker: host
pa30.text: Reminder: the time is. The time is.

pa31.speaker: host
pa31.text: All personnel report to. Thank you.

pa32.speaker: host
pa32.text: ATTENTION. Feed cycle complete. Feed cycle. Feed.

pa34.speaker: host
pa34.text: Hand contact with stock is permitted. Is not permitted.

pa35.speaker: host
pa35.text: ATTENTION. Muster point is where you are standing.

pa36.speaker: host
pa36.text: Please remain where you are. Please remain.

pa37.speaker: host
pa37.text: This has been a recorded announcement. This has been.

pa38.speaker: host
pa38.text: Good morning, Hesper-4. Good morning. Good morning.

pa39.speaker: emergency
pa39.text: Pressure seal fault, deck two. Clear the corridor.

pa40.speaker: emergency
pa40.text: Coolant leak, sub-level. Clear the corridor.

pa41.speaker: emergency
pa41.text: Stand clear of the pens. Stand clear.

pa42.speaker: emergency
pa42.text: Fire team to processing. Fire team to processing.

pa44.speaker: emergency
pa44.text: Containment fault, processing. This is not a drill.

pa45.speaker: emergency
pa45.text: Seal the deck. Seal the deck.

pa46.speaker: emergency
pa46.text: Do not use the lifts. Do not use the lifts.

pa47.speaker: emergency
pa47.text: Muster is cancelled. Return to your stations.

pa49.speaker: emergency
pa49.text: Do not open the cold store.

pa50.speaker: emergency
pa50.text: Power to deck lighting has been withdrawn.

pa51.speaker: emergency
pa51.text: This is not a drill. This is not a drill. This is not

pa52.speaker: survivor
pa52.text: Hello? Is this thing - hello? Is anyone on this channel?

pa53.speaker: survivor
pa53.text: We're in the cold store. Deck six. Please. Somebody.

pa54.speaker: survivor
pa54.text: Don't open it. Don't open it. DON'T -

pa55.speaker: survivor
pa55.text: It's in the vent. It's in the vent, Marcus, it's -

pa56.speaker: survivor
pa56.text: Get the door. GET THE DOOR!

pa57.speaker: survivor
pa57.text: Is this going anywhere? Is anybody - okay. Okay.

pa58.speaker: survivor
pa58.text: Tell Marion I - tell her I tried the lift.

pa59.speaker: survivor
pa59.text: Stop banging. Stop banging, they can hear it.

pa60.speaker: survivor
pa60.text: We counted eleven. We counted eleven and then we stopped.

pa61.speaker: survivor
pa61.text: Please. Please. I've got a kid on Luna.

pa62.speaker: survivor
pa62.text: Doyle. Doyle, if that's you, open the hatch!

pa63.speaker: survivor
pa63.text: Whoever's got the pass card. Whoever's got it. Please.

pa64.speaker: survivor
pa64.text: They're quiet now. Why are they quiet now.

pa65.speaker: survivor
pa65.text: The lights keep - something's chewing the cable.

pa67.speaker: survivor
pa67.text: Just static. It's just static now.

pa68.speaker: survivor
pa68.text: If you can hear this, don't come down. Don't come down.

pa69.speaker: survivor
pa69.text: I can see the lift. I can see it. I can't -

pa71.speaker: survivor
pa71.text: Three of us. Two. Two of us.

pa72.speaker: survivor
pa72.text: OPEN UP! Open up, open up, open -
